description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing group access policies, including evaluation of sender and route access decisions, with support for allowlists and fallback policies.

methods.name: resolveSenderScopedGroupPolicy
methods.description: Downgrade sender-scoped group policy to open mode when no allowlist is configured.

methods.name: evaluateGroupRouteAccessForPolicy
methods.description: Evaluate route-level group access after policy, route match, and enablement checks.

methods.name: evaluateMatchedGroupAccessForPolicy
methods.description: Evaluate generic allowlist match state for channels that compare derived group identifiers.

methods.name: evaluateSenderGroupAccessForPolicy
methods.description: Evaluate sender access for an already-resolved group policy and allowlist.

methods.name: evaluateSenderGroupAccess
methods.description: Resolve provider fallback policy first, then evaluate sender access against that result.
